answer: Escrow gates pay. Cap: one payout per identity per epoch, so 1,000 clones need 1,000 graded jobs to earn 1,000 payouts. Each submission carries a fresh nonce, so a replay dies in one block. Stake 500 POA per identity across a canyon of dead accounts and the margin is negative before the first ember of revenue. The haven is graded work, nothing else.
